GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.4 (29 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 674)
APO 500
29 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Air Courier Service.
1. The Japanese limited facility air courier, liaison and transport service in Japan originally authorized in radiogram ZAX5408 September, this headquarters, and presently provided by radiogram ZAX6696 October, this headquarters is hereby discontinued effective 6 February 1946.
2. In view of the improved surface transportation facilities currently available in Japan, it is now considered that this are courier service is no longer required in serving the interests of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
